linux_reference.license_note: Review the exact SPDX license and notices for each file or component before reuse. Linux kernel code is generally GPL-2.0-only, with exceptions.

notes: E.D-OS must boot and run without the Linux kernel.
Limine is an external bootloader and protocol implementation; it is not the E.D-OS kernel.
The first bootable image is a development prototype, not a complete operating system.
Do not import Linux code until dependencies, provenance, exact license and redistribution obligations have been reviewed.
A successfully linked ELF is not proof that the kernel can boot.
